case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You explained your pricing through labour and material costs, and you want a binding agreement that gives your plant steady business. That is what our options are built around: each one is a contract term that runs well beyond a single year, so your capacity is planned with more certainty.

On quality:
Your quality was 302 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you the longer term and the best unit price of the three, which reflects the quality level above and the stability a longer commitment brings.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.52; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.54; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

As you have the authority to pass this on but perhaps not to decide it, I would ask you to take Option A to the person who decides on your side. In plain words, it offers Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd a firm multi-year agreement for the ball bearing 6306 with a fixed price and payment term, so that your team can plan the volume ahead and we can both rely on it. We would pay every invoice on its agreed due date.

To help your colleague review it, we would welcome some detail:
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Thank you for your help in bringing this forward. We would like to find a fair solution for both family companies.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. Regarding your request, we are unable to provide a detailed cost breakdown due to our company policy. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month agreement and can accommodate the 45-day payment term. For this 24-month term with 45-day payment, our best possible price is €4.90 per unit.

Our current Angebot is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, we can offer a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for checking the quality record and for confirming that it holds. You have said that only multi-year volume agreements change prices, and that is exactly the kind of agreement our options offer: each one runs for a longer term, which gives your plant steadier business to plan with.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.62; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.59; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It keeps the long term you asked for and gives both family companies a fair unit price. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

So that you can take it forward easily, here is a short paragraph for your decision-maker.

Option A gives Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd a long-term agreement for ball bearing 6306 with a customer whose quality record is confirmed. It brings planned, steady use of your capacity for the whole term.

Mr Gruber, would you please take Option A to the person who decides and let us know the answer? We would much prefer to settle this with you as a lasting arrangement between two family firms.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have discussed your proposal internally as requested. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Our Angebot stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

As an alternative, for the 24-month term with a 45-day payment period, we can offer a revised price of €4.89 per unit, with terms of a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

You mention a volume agreement, but we would need specific volume figures to evaluate any impact on our calculation. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You asked which volume we can commit to, and a binding higher volume is what you said would help.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.61; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.66; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.63; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 20,000 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you the shortest payment term you have already said you can accommodate, together with the binding volume you asked for. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since this decision goes beyond your own desk, here is a short paragraph for the person who decides on your side. Option A gives Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd a binding annual volume for two full years, a payment term your team has already said it can meet, and a family-owned customer who plans with you for the long term. It is a clear, fair solution for both family companies.

Could you take Option A to that person and let us know the answer? We would much prefer to settle this together.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for specifying the binding volume of 20,000 units per year. We have reviewed this with our management as requested, but this volume does not change our calculation enough to allow for further price reductions. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We are pleased to present our offer with a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, and a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. 

It is always a pleasure to serve you with our broad range and high-standard service, and we look forward to continuing our great cooperation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
